sentence: This project builds a national system that helps patients with rare conditions who are undiagnosed get answers and care.
This project tests a theory of how the hippocampus and visual cortex work together to help the brain learn to tell similar things apart.
This project tests whether RNA nanoparticles can make pancreatic tumor stroma normal and help chemotherapy and immunotherapy work better.
This project tries to find out how liver cells decide whether to store lipids in lipid droplets or secrete them as lipoproteins.
This project studies whether signals from large language models can measure the symptoms of depression and anxiety.
This project adapts and tests a set of care steps to help young adult cancer survivors in a rural region get reproductive health care.
This project uses hair follicle stem cells to find genes that can make old stem cells young again or make them age.
This project tries to find out whether hydrogen peroxide in mitochondria controls how neuronal mitochondria split and fuse.
This project studies how Notch and Wnt signaling shape the tissue niche after lung injury and affect whether the lung repairs itself well.
This project studies how eye lens crystallins change when activated and tests whether the activated crystallins protect cells under stress.
This project tries to make the earliest dental progenitor cells from human induced pluripotent stem cells so they can form a tooth.
This project tries to find out how a mutation in a protein that processes RNA changes cell function in a chronic blood disorder.
This project tries to find out how capillary endothelial cells in the lung and epithelial cells interact during lung development.
This project develops drugs that block both a viral main protease and a host protein called cathepsin L to fight the coronavirus.
This project builds a fast imaging system that uses artificial intelligence to watch how tumor organoids respond to anti-cancer drugs.
This project develops a method that uses machine learning and small molecule catalysts to change arene rings in drug compounds.
This project tests a drug alone and together with decitabine in a clinical trial for patients with myelodysplastic syndromes.
This project studies how a protein called Merlin shapes the cells and tissue structure where pancreatic endocrine cells are born.
This project develops rational strategies to treat brain metastases from breast cancer using antibody drug conjugates and ways to boost anti-tumor immunity.
This project builds automatic tools that check the quality of MRI images and correct artifacts in studies that collect data at multiple sites.
